newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-DEVILS' GILMOUR TO MISS TWO GAMES.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-DEVILS' GILMOUR TO MISS TWO GAMES.

text.p: New Jersey Devils centre Doug Gilmour, whose acquisition from Toronto late last month sparked the team to a five-game winning streak, will miss two games with contusions above and below his left eye, team officials announced Thursday.

Gilmour, who has 32 points in 21 games since the All-Star break, was struck in the face by a puck off the stick of Philadelphia's Eric Desjardins late in the third period of Wednesday's 3-1 victory over the Flyers.
A team spokesman described the injury as "nothing serious," but said the 33-year-old Gilmour will miss games Saturday at Long Island and Sunday at Buffalo.

The Devils, the NHL's hottest team, are 5-0 since trading three players to the Maple Leafs on February 25 for Gilmour and defenceman Dave Ellett. New Jersey is 11-1-7 in its last 19 games and moved within four points of first-place Philadelphia with Wednesday's win.
The Flyers' game was Gilmour's first with New Jersey in which he did not score at least one point. He is tied for 13th in the NHL in scoring with 19 goals and 50 assists in 66 games.
